text: まだまだ…　これからだ　あちこちの　くさむらに　はいって　ポケモンを　つかまえるのじゃ！

structure.jp: あちこちの　くさむらに　はいって
structure.en: go into tall grass here and there, and

structure.jp: ポケモンを　つかまえるのじゃ！

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ after a plain verb can be a firm instruction: 'you are to do this'. じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. つかまえるのじゃ = 'go and catch them!'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and then'. くさむらに はいって = 'go into the grass and'.
